messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not take it for longer than 14 days"
set: ["do not take it for longer than 14 days", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "do not take more than recommended", "do not take more than prescribed", "do not take within 5 days before or 14 days after using an MAO inhibitor", "do not use in larger amounts or for longer than recommended", "do not take more than recommended dose", "do not take more than prescribed dose", "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor", "starting dose for first 14 days", "do not use within 14 days before MAO inhibitor use", "do not save it for later use", "do not take more or less than prescribed", "never take in larger amounts or for longer than prescribed", "results take longer", "do not use in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
